prism_card_a.prompt: Make a tall hero card picture of the girl superhero in the FIRST picture. Keep her exactly the same: her face, light tan skin, brown eyes, long high blond ponytail, white and purple suit with purple shoulder pads, the rainbow gem on her chest, gold belt with a purple gem, white gloves with purple cuffs, purple leggings, white boots with gold tops and her rainbow cape. Use the SECOND picture only for the card style: a glossy 3D cartoon render with the hero big in the frame and an exciting magical background (do not copy that character, her wand or the moon). Pose: a confident, happy hero pose, one arm raised high with a bright rainbow beam shooting up from her glove, the other hand in a fist, her rainbow cape flowing in the wind. Background: a purple and blue sky with soft rainbow light rays and twinkling sparkles. Her whole body from head to boots inside the picture. No text, no letters, no logo, no frame.
